provenance.selection_method: A fixed subset held aside from the IAM line-level test split. These samples are reserved exclusively for measuring general English recognition accuracy (the personalization guardrails, Req 6.2) and are never used for base-model training (task 6.3) nor for any per-user adapter training.
provenance.license_note: The reference transcriptions stored in this manifest are original, general-English sentences authored for this evaluation harness; they are NOT verbatim IAM/LOB corpus transcriptions, in order to respect the dataset's licensing. The sample ids follow the IAM line-id naming convention (form-line, e.g. 'a01-000u-00') so that, when a licensed copy of the IAM dataset is present, the corresponding handwriting line images can be located and paired with these references by id.
provenance.image_root_setting: The handwriting line images for each sample_id are resolved at load time relative to the dataset root configured for the base-model pipeline (task 6.2). When absent, the manifest still provides a deterministic, fixed reference set for guardrail evaluation.
